articles.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
articles.snippet: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.

articles.title: OpenAI Turns the Tables on Apple With Its Own Trade-Secret Theft Claims
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker’s counterclaims flip the script on a dispute Apple started in July, alleging the iPhone maker took its trade secrets and pressured shared hardware suppliers to freeze it out of the AI-device race.

articles.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
articles.snippet: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

articles.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
articles.snippet: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

articles.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
articles.snippet: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.
